Review protocol amendments, protocol letters, and study communications to determine impacts on coverage analysis, contracts, and budgets, and implement necessary changes resulting from these amendments. Use Microsoft Office applications, primarily Excel, to support enhancements to budget templates and tools for improved efficiency and ease of use. Collaborate effectively with post-award teams to resolve issues, understand downstream impacts of finalized budgets and contracts, and support process improvements that streamline post-award workflows. About the Role: We are looking for a hands-on AI Budget Development Consultant to help us automate one of our most time-intensive and manually driven business workflows using Perplexity Enterprise Pro — our enterprise AI platform. We have two core tools that currently operate independently — a Statement of Work spreadsheet that captures all the services, activities, assumptions, and effort estimates for a given clinical trial study, and a Life of Study budget workbook that captures the financial projections for that same study. Right now staff manually translate information between the two tools which is duplicative, time-consuming, and introduces variability and inconsistency — especially when protocol information is incomplete upfront. Your job is to build a Perplexity-enabled solution that reads completed SOW content and automatically pre-populates Life of Study budget inputs — and vice versa — so that our managers and directors are refining a data-informed baseline rather than starting effort estimations from scratch every time. We have approximately 30 existing SOWs and years of historical Life of Study budgets across our active study portfolio that you will use as training examples to build and test the solution. The solution also needs to generate cost saving recommendations and flag items requiring closer review for budgeting accuracy — including areas where effort may be under-budgeted, over-budgeted, incomplete, or inconsistent with study assumptions. This is a solo individual contributor role. There is no project manager. You own the work end to end from requirements gathering through solution development, proof of concept, implementation, and knowledge transfer What You Will Do: Review and deeply understand both the SOW workbook and the Life of Study budget workbook — their structure, data fields, logic, and how information flows between them Define how Perplexity will be used to interpret and normalize SOW content into recommended Life of Study budget inputs including rules, prompts, exception handling, and required human review points Build data mapping and business rules that connect SOW services, assumptions, units of work, estimated hours, and direct cost logic to Life of Study budget stages, effort allocation structures, and budget categories Develop and test a prototype or minimum viable solution demonstrating how SOW information is translated into draft Life of Study budget inputs for user review and refinement Build a review and exception framework that highlights recommended checkpoints for accuracy, missing information, unusual effort patterns, and potential under or over budgeting Generate cost saving recommendations by analyzing how SOW services and assumptions drive Life of Study budget costs and identifying areas where effort or direct costs may be reduced with minimal impact to study quality Test the solution using representative study scenarios and refine it for robustness, consistency, and operational usability Manag
